test_counts.note: Includes repeated audit probes; one initial workflow failure was an audit fixture error corrected without application changes. Performance collector originally passed as a measurement harness; its acceptance gate fails.

findings.title: Concurrent chat exhausts the database pool before admission control
findings.root: The request dependency holds an authenticated DB session while find_conversation and generation preparation open additional sessions. The limiter runs after the second lookup. Default pool size 5 plus overflow 5 is exhausted by ten simultaneous request-scoped sessions.
findings.impact: Authenticated callers can cause request stalls and HTTP 500s; shared per-process pool pressure can degrade other tenants. No cross-tenant data disclosure was observed.
findings.repro: Run AUDIT_CONFIRM_POOL=1 with the staged-performance audit test. Fresh confirmation: 9/10 HTTP 500; QueuePool size 5 overflow 5 timeout 30 seconds. Original 10/50/100 stages all returned HTTP 500.
findings.fix: Release request authentication transactions before slow chat work, avoid nested pool checkouts, and apply admission/backpressure before acquiring scarce DB sessions. Bound pool wait and map overload to controlled 429/503. Re-test cross-tenant fairness.
findings.test: Ten concurrent chat requests with default pool must complete or receive documented admission limits, with zero 500s. Include a second tenant health/read request during saturation.

findings.title: Citation eligibility can include a source absent from the rendered prompt
findings.root: render_context counts escaped characters and may stop before rendering all selected chunks. assemble returns the original selected list; citations_for validates against that list, not rendered sources.
findings.impact: An answer marker can receive apparently valid provenance for evidence the model never saw. This is not a cross-tenant leak: affected chunks are still tenant-scoped.
findings.repro: Supply first passage consisting of 2,500 ampersands and a second passage. With a 16,000-byte prompt budget, escaping expands the first passage past render_context's 12,000-character ceiling. Source 2 is absent from the prompt, but Answer [2] still produces its citation.
findings.fix: Return the exact rendered source set/IDs from prompt assembly and validate citation markers against it. Budget escaped content consistently.
findings.test: test_citations_must_only_reference_sources_actually_rendered currently fails; cover HTML expansion, metadata overhead and partially omitted sources.

findings.title: Production permits HTTP embedding endpoints
findings.root: Production guards reject hash embeddings but do not require HTTPS for EMBEDDING_BASE_URL. OpenAICompatibleEmbedder accepts http and attaches bearer credentials plus document content.
findings.impact: If an operator configures HTTP in production, embedding keys and customer text can travel without TLS. Current local configuration contains no real key; no actual credential disclosure was performed or observed.
findings.repro: The audit production-settings test supplies an HTTP embedding base URL and otherwise valid synthetic production settings. No ValidationError is raised.
findings.fix: Require HTTPS in production/staging as appropriate, reject credentials/query fragments in provider URLs, and disable or strictly validate cross-host redirects.
findings.test: test_production_embedding_transport_must_require_https currently fails. Add redirect/certificate validation tests with fixture credentials.

findings.title: Production proxy headers trust every peer
findings.impact: If the API is reachable outside a strictly trusted proxy boundary, forged forwarded addresses can evade IP limits and distort audit IP metadata. Token/org limits remain independent barriers. Actual public deployment topology was not tested.
findings.repro: Static: inspect the runtime CMD. In a disposable deployment, send differing X-Forwarded-For values directly and observe request.client-derived limits.
findings.fix: Restrict trusted proxy CIDRs and deny direct ingress; add a deployment assertion and forged-header regression.
findings.test: Direct untrusted connections cannot choose the limiter IP; trusted proxy chains resolve the intended client.

findings.title: Document parser lacks hard worker time/resource isolation
findings.root: Format and extraction limits exist, but parsing runs in-process and tasks have no configured soft/hard execution deadlines. Worker containers have no explicit resource limits in Compose.
findings.impact: A pathological but size-compliant document could monopolize ingestion workers or memory. This is a static hardening gap; an exploit PDF/worker kill was not executed.
findings.repro: Inspect task configuration and extract_stored/parse paths; test with a bounded slow parser fixture rather than an unbounded malicious payload.
findings.fix: Add bounded parsing in a constrained process plus worker soft/hard deadlines, memory/CPU limits and safe failure recovery.
findings.test: A fixture parser exceeding its wall-clock budget is terminated, marks the job safely and does not starve another tenant.

findings.title: Conversation inbox still displays a placeholder empty state
findings.root: The screen fetches chatbot options but does not load stored conversations. Filters are disabled and the empty state is unconditional.
findings.impact: Stored public/widget conversations cannot be reviewed from this inbox despite the implemented API and playground history. Advanced Phase 7 analytics are outside this audit; the present placeholder should be labelled accurately.
findings.repro: Persist a conversation, open Conversations, inspect the component/request behavior; no transcript query is made by this screen.
findings.fix: Within the agreed MVP scope, surface existing conversation data or explicitly communicate the limitation; do not claim the inbox complete.
findings.test: After saving a widget conversation, inbox refresh displays it or an explicit unavailable-feature state.

findings.title: Repeated installation has no deduplication or teardown
findings.root: Every script execution appends another iframe and window message listener. There is no per-key instance registry or cleanup API.
findings.impact: Accidental duplicate tags or SPA remounts can create overlapping launchers and extra session issuance. Different-key isolation passed; repeated same-key behavior has only static evidence here.
findings.repro: Install the same script/key twice and inspect iframe/listener count; the source contains an unconditional append.
findings.fix: Define idempotent default initialization with an explicit multi-instance opt-in and remove listeners/frames during teardown.
findings.test: Repeated initialization of one key yields the documented instance count and no extra stale listeners.
